q2_gaps: equative copular clause whose complement is a proper name ("The father of X was Michele Michele Emmer") - the categorical rules cover "X is a/an N" and "X is ADJ" but define no identity relation for two referring expressions, and a name cannot go in a class slot
notes: The parse resolves the equative by inverting it - typing the named individual as father and attaching the possessor with Possession (possessed first), matching the "her sister" genitive example - and Past-wraps the appositive typings per the host-clause rule. The duplicated "Michele Michele" is preserved verbatim in the Name string as required.
